about.label: About Wisma Apollo
about.title: Why Choose Wisma Apollo?
about.desc1: Wisma Apollo Kuala Kurun is the perfect accommodation for those who need a comfortable, clean, and quiet place to rest. Strategically located near the city center, ideal for families and business trips.
about.desc2: All rooms come with full AC, free Wi-Fi, comfortable spring beds with goose feather pillows, full cotton linen sheets and bed covers, shower bathrooms, soft & clean towels daily (Breakfast by Request). For privacy and tranquility, we use soundproof walls and ceilings, so you can rest undisturbed. Extra beds & pillows are available upon request.
about.desc3: Book now and experience the comfort of staying at the best and most affordable accommodation in Kuala Kurun. Contact us via WhatsApp and book your room easily!

faq.pageDesc: Find answers about location, room rates, facilities, and how to book at Wisma Apollo Kuala Kurun.
faq.contactUs: Contact us directly via WhatsApp for quick answers and room reservations.

items.a: Wisma Apollo is located at Jl. Letjen Soeprapto No.56, Kuala Kurun, Kel. Tampang Tumbang Anjir, Kec. Kurun, Gunung Mas Regency, Central Kalimantan 74571. It's strategically positioned in the city center.

items.q: How much is a room per night?
items.a: Room rates start from Rp200,000/night for Single Bed and Rp250,000/night for Double Bed. Includes AC, WiFi, 32" Android TV, and bathroom amenities.
Every room is equipped with AC, 32" Android TV, free WiFi, en-suite shower bathroom, spring bed + goose feather pillows, cotton linen, fresh towels daily, and soundproof walls.
Yes, the entire Wisma Apollo area has free WiFi with adequate speed for streaming and working.
Reservations can be made through WhatsApp at 0818 232 021. Simply send a message with your name and desired check-in dates. We will respond quickly.
Yes, breakfast is available by request with an additional fee of Rp20,000 per person. Contact the receptionist to order breakfast.
Yes, extra beds and pillows are available at Rp50,000 per room. Please inform us when making your reservation.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM WIB and check-out is by 12:00 PM WIB. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged depending on availability.
